column1: # NATO APP-6C unit icons, authored from the standard's own icon descriptions.
# Tab-separated: variant, display name, SIDC dimension letter, subpaths.
# Each subpath is prefixed F (closed, filled) or S (open, stroked).
# Coordinates are em over a 1000x1000 box, y DOWN, origin at the icon centre.
# Grammar: M x y | L x y | A cx cy r a0 a1 (degrees) | Z.
